policy: primary = theoretical (vendor SKU table, auditable/conservative); measured peaks are supplementary and reported next to the primary value

measured.compute_method: torch bf16 matmul 8192^3, 3 warmup + 15 reps, median -> 370.5 TFLOPS (98.0% of 378)
measured.bandwidth_method: bf16 copy_ 512 MiB, 20 reps, median -> 1.424 TB/s read+write (89.0% of 1.6)
measured.bandwidth_tier_resolution: measured 1.424 > 1.4 rules out the 1.4 TB/s tier; 128 GiB also matches the 1.6 TB/s SKU

provenance.estimated: fp32/fp8 cube peaks scale the measured bf16 ratio (0.980) onto the vendor values; re-calibrate per dtype before claiming those

acceptance.note: MFU = achieved FLOPs / (T_op * peak). MU is diagnostic only and never decides pass/fail. The 90% value is the 'others' tier from the requirement; per-operator overrides can be added later.
